candidate_evidence.quote: This is to study if neoadjuvant atezolizumab therapy is beneficial for patients with recurrent glioblastoma and a low mutational burden.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Clinical or radiologic evidence of first or second recurrence following radiation and TMZ.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Biological assessments of specimens collected in this trial will test the relationship between low TMB and features associated with immune-editing in rGBM.

role_evidence.quote: 80 patients with rGBM who are eligible for surgical debulking will be treated with one dose of atezolizumab prior to resection.

source_quote.quote: Anticipating that40 patients with low TMB and 40 with high TMB will be treated.

flag.reason: TMB (by WES of resected tissue) defines prospective low vs high comparison groups rather than an entry requirement; brief summary frames the trial around low-TMB patients, so enrichment could be argued, which would affect the primary outcome.

coder_notes: Single-arm neoadjuvant + adjuvant atezolizumab in recurrent IDH-wt GBM; outcomes compared between low vs high TMB groups (determined by WES on resected tissue after the pre-surgical dose) and with matched historical controls. TMB is not an inclusion criterion; coded as stratification (prospective analysis groups) and candidate-matched as a checkpoint-inhibitor response biomarker. Target engagement unclear: tissue immune-editing features are studied in relation to TMB, but no explicit pharmacodynamic endpoint for atezolizumab. Bevacizumab is mentioned only as permitted for inflammatory side effects, not a study intervention, so not listed.
